option_relations.rationale: Ectopic Atrial Tachycardia is a distinct type of atrial tachycardia, not directly equivalent to or a subtype/supertype of Intra-atrial reentrant tachycardia (IART) with variable atrioventricular block. While both are supraventricular tachycardias, their mechanisms differ.

The option 'Intra-atrial reentrant tachycardia (IART) with variable atrioventricular block' is identical to the provided leaf 'Intra-atrial reentrant tachycardia (IART) with variable atrioventricular block'.
Atrial Tachycardia with variable block is a broader category that includes Intra-atrial reentrant tachycardia (IART) with variable atrioventricular block as a specific type of atrial tachycardia.

Atrial Flutter with variable conduction is a distinct arrhythmia with a different mechanism and ECG characteristics compared to Intra-atrial reentrant tachycardia (IART) with variable atrioventricular block.
